text: This November... Iran erased a line.
2,000 km. As far as its missiles were meant to fly.
Inside it: Israel. The Gulf. Every American base in the region.
Then, in March: two missiles flew toward Diego Garcia, about 4,000 km away.
Britain says one failed, and one was shot down. Iran denies firing them.
Now its Revolutionary Guard says the limit is gone.
That takes an intercontinental missile. Iran is not known to have one.
US intelligence says it could build one by 2035, if it decides to.
The line is gone. The distance isn't.
